theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (Ω : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u Ω → (∀ P : Amb n ℓ → Prop, (∀ᵐ y ∂V.weight, P y) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict Ω), P (q (graphPoint x (u x)))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict Ω), V.tangentProj (q (graphPoint x (u x))) = (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ u x v)))).starProjection
